verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs state the story nearly verbatim: Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second and scale out to tens of thousands when traffic arrives. Supporting docs describe fast-launching VMs, `fly scale` for horizontal scaling, and a REST API for creating Machines. Community reports of stuck or failed deploys temper confidence but do not concretely contradict the boot-time or scale claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sub-second boot times and of scaling to tens of thousands, and detailed docs on load-driven autoscaling behavior and limits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load

citations.quote: Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second, run close to your users, and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives.
Fly Machines are fast-launching VMs with a simple REST API.
the `fly scale` command for quick horizontal and vertical scaling
